title: 听力挑战 · 论文咨询

rounds.speaker: 导师
rounds.line: Having reviewed your draft, I suggest focusing on the discussion section before submitting it.
rounds.lineCn: 审阅了你的初稿之后,我建议你在提交之前重点修改讨论部分。

grammar.name: 现在分词完成式作状语
grammar.note: Having reviewed 表示动作发生在主句之前(先审阅、后建议);suggest doing 接动名词作宾语。

options.text: The professor advises improving the discussion section first.
options.feedback: 建议的重点正是提交前完善讨论部分。

options.text: The professor advises rewriting the introduction section.
options.feedback: 导师强调的是讨论部分,不是引言。

options.text: The professor advises submitting the draft immediately.
options.feedback: 原文是修改后再提交,不能立即提交。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: Considering the limited time, we decide to shorten the literature review rather than omit it entirely.
rounds.lineCn: 考虑到时间有限,我们决定缩短文献综述,而不是完全删掉它。

grammar.name: 现在分词状语 + rather than 结构
grammar.note: Considering the limited time 是分词短语作原因状语;rather than 连接两个并列选择,强调选择前者。

options.text: They will make the literature review shorter, not delete it.
options.feedback: 决定是缩短文献综述而非完全删除。

options.text: They will omit the literature review completely.
options.feedback: 原文明确表示不会完全删掉。

options.text: They will extend the literature review to more chapters.

rounds.speaker: 导师
rounds.line: The data being analyzed now will determine whether your hypothesis is supported by the evidence.
rounds.lineCn: 目前正在分析的数据将决定你的假设能否得到证据支持。

grammar.name: 被动分词作定语
grammar.note: being analyzed 是现在分词被动式作定语,表示正在进行中的分析;后接 whether 引导的宾语从句。

options.text: The analysis of the data will show whether the hypothesis holds.
options.feedback: 数据分析的结果将检验假设是否成立。

options.text: The data will be discarded because they are unusable.
options.feedback: 原文没有说数据会被弃用。

options.text: The hypothesis has already been confirmed by other researchers.
options.feedback: 假设是否成立要等数据分析结果,尚未证实。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: Time permitting, we will present our findings at the conference next month without any delay.
rounds.lineCn: 如果时间允许,我们将如期在下个月的会议上展示我们的发现。

grammar.name: 独立主格结构
grammar.note: Time permitting 是名词+现在分词构成的独立主格,表条件(如果时间允许),主句主语与之不同。

options.text: They plan to present the findings at the conference next month.
options.feedback: 时间允许的话,下个月会议如期展示成果。

options.text: They plan to cancel the presentation at the conference.
options.feedback: 原文是要准时参加并展示,不是取消。

options.text: They will delay the presentation until next year.
options.feedback: 原文明确说 without any delay,不会推迟。
